messages:
alex: Scheduling a config-only deploy during tonight's change window at 22:30 PT. Targets: per-tenant timeout tweak, routing weights, and tinybatch.window. config id cfg-7459873210. Plan: 8% canary for 12m, then 25% for 10m if green.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by alex — canary 8% for 12m across us-west and eu-central. Rollout id cfg-7459873210. Observability: https://dash/reports/cfg-7459873210 

rhea: Ack. I'll watch 5xx, 99p latencies, and error budget. Smoke checklist: 30 synthetic requests per region, check kv-cache misses, and model variant pin. Alert: 5xx > 0.4% or 99p > 700ms -> pause.

sam: Note: we should pin the model to v1.4-alpha to avoid kv schema drift. Also enabling tenant stickiness for high-priority tenants.

alex: Applied: model.pin=v1.4-alpha, routing.sticky=high-priority, tinybatch.window=40ms -> 25ms, timeout.per_request background=14s -> 11s.

deploy-bot: Canary started (8%). If you need to pause: `/deploybot pause cfg-7459873210`. To rollback: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7459873210`. Logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -f deploy/cfg-7459873210`

ops-bot: Anomaly detected: eu-central 99p latency spike to 820ms at +3m into canary. KV-cache miss rate increased for tenant-eu-sme.

rhea: I'm seeing errors in the kvcache warmup: `WARN kvcache.prewarm: seed miss ratio=0.36 tenant=tenant-eu-sme`. Throttling canary to 3% and pausing rollforward to investigate.

sam: Suggest partial rollback of tinybatch.window and routing.sticky while keeping model.pin. Proposed command: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7459873210 --targets tinybatch,routing --reason "eu kvcache miss spike"`

alex: Running partial rollback now. I'll send a brief to CS for affected tenants and schedule a targeted kv warmup run. Holding canary until we confirm reduced miss ratio.

deploy-bot: Partial rollback done at 7459873275. Canary paused. Rollback notes: tinybatch.window restored to 40ms, routing.sticky reverted, model.pin retained (v1.4-alpha). Next: run kv prewarm script and re-run canary with slower ramp.
